parsed.faithful: The proper comitia were of three sorts, curiata, centuriata, and tributa, with reference to the three grand divisions of the city and people into curiae, centuries, and tribes: for by comitia calata were meant all the comitia in general, the term calata (from calare, i.e., vocare) being their common epithet, though it was at last restricted to assemblies for the creation of priests, and the regulation of last wills and testaments, to which the people acted as witnesses merely.
